integrity: The upper bound is analytic: an isometric embedding into a three-coordinate sup-norm plane reduces the problem to a dual-norm lemma and a one-variable weighted AM-GM optimization. Both branches have explicit attaining families. The bundled checker verifies the finite dual-norm lemma and all symbolic branch identities; finite sampling is only supplementary. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the affine-regular hexagonal Banach plane. It does not classify generalized Zbăganu profiles for all regular polygons or all absolute normalized norms, and it does not classify every extremizing pair.
title: Complete generalized Zbăganu profile of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
